title: Slurry-as-a-Service: A Modest Proposal on Scalable Pluralistic Alignment for Nutrient Optimization
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a framework for pluralistic alignment to human values and morals. It specifically discusses aligning models to 'community constitutions of morals' (including templates for 'Faith-Based Mulching') and benchmarks these systems using 'MulchBench' to measure governance compliance and alignment with specific moral frameworks.
